What We Coat for Guelph Businesses

We coat steel and aluminum parts for Guelph businesses, from small brackets to heavy welded frames. Each part is cleaned, pretreated, sprayed with thermoset powder and cured, so the finish resists chips, corrosion and everyday wear.

Typical powder coating Guelph orders can include conveyor frames, machine guards, railings, enclosures, trailer parts, shelving and equipment housings. Electrostatic spray wraps powder around edges and corners, and chemical pretreatment readies the surface so the coating bonds and corrosion resistance lasts. The outcome is a chip-resistant finish that keeps its look indoors and, with the right powder, outdoors.

Our curing oven supports parts up to 6,000 lb, so a large part and a batch of small brackets can share one order. Each metal needs different prep, so we confirm the powder and colour with you before spraying. Powder Coating Guelph FAQs

Short answer: orders go smoothly when pickup, timing and finish are agreed before parts arrive. These answers cover delivery, timing, written quotes, mixed metals, repeat colours and visiting hours for Guelph customers.

blocks.q: Do you offer pickup and delivery for powder coating in Guelph?
blocks.a: Yes, we offer both. Tell us your address, part sizes and quantity when you request a quote, and we will confirm whether it suits your order. You can also drop parts at our Milton shop during opening hours.

blocks.q: When will my Guelph powder coating be ready?
blocks.a: We work to a 48 hour turnaround. Heavy rust removal, large parts or high volume can add time, so we confirm the schedule when you send details. Tell us your install date and we will plan back from it.

blocks.q: How do I get a written quote?
blocks.a: Send photos, size, metal type, quantity and the colour or RAL code you want, and mention any threads or surfaces that must stay bare. We reply with the prep method, powder and timing, so you can compare the quote against your purchase order.

blocks.q: Can steel and aluminum share one order?
blocks.a: Yes. Steel parts and aluminum parts need different prep, so label which is which and we will plan the cleaning and pretreatment for each. Both can then be coated in the same colour so an assembly matches.

blocks.q: Can I reorder the same colour later?
blocks.a: Yes. We record the colour code for each job, so a repeat order can match the original. Guelph powder coating reorders go smoother when you quote the earlier job and its code.

blocks.q: When can I visit the shop with parts?
blocks.a: We are open Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM at 10874 Steeles Ave E, Milton, ON L9T 2X8. Call (905) 876-7060 first so we can confirm timing for your powder coating Guelph order.
